cohort: Women undergoing Cesarean section between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation
finding: The study found that while elective Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery for women with preeclampsia, neonates delivered by emergency Cesarean section did not experience adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Neonates born via emergency Cesarean section to mothers with preeclampsia had significantly higher Apgar scores and umbilical cord pH values compared to those born via elective Cesarean section.
